about: Worked examples for the Claude prompt reader, made from prompts that were read wrong. Find candidates with GET /learn/misreads; add one here once a misread is confirmed. Kept across patches: an example is skipped if any of its names no longer exists.

examples.means: ascendancy Abyssal Lich (Witch). It is its own ascendancy, not Lich.
ailment bleed. Here 'bleed' is the ailment, not a support gem, so no anchor_support.
ascendancy Shaman (Druid), kinds bear, skill Furious Slam.
